title: Absolut zu empfehlen bei Zeitblindheit
body: Ich danke von Herzen für diese eine App, die genau auf mein Gehirn zugeschnitten ist. Das Update heute ist perfektioniert es, aber ich war vorher schon bis auf die Performance an manchen Punkten völlig zufrieden und begeistert. Jetzt ist auch das gelöst und das Erlebnis an den entscheidenden Punkten noch geschmeidiger. Dafür ist es das Geld tatsächlich wert! Danke! Fühl mich euch verbunden!

title: Perfect interface for time blocking method
body: I’ve been building and tweaking my calendars for years to find something that works for me. Since a while I’ve been using a time blocking method that I’m still adjusting to fit my natural workflow. Weel is the best interface for this method I’ve found so far - I love how smooth and easy it is to use. It’s visually clean and beautiful - I see all the most important information at once without overwhelm, which give me also instant clues how to adapt my schedule further, that otherwise I’d miss in Google calendar. The setup was quick and straightforward for my impatient mind. Highly recommended.
author: Zubra86

title: amazing concept, unfortunately a little buggy
body:
Circular Calendars are the future.
Time is continuous.
When I discovered PiCal I was mindblown by the concept. It looks amazing and works great at first sight. Unfortunately I encountered a few glitches and app crashes and was frustrated. So I contacted the developer on WhatsApp and have to say I am amazed by the support.
The team is small but they make an effort to improve.

Giving the full 5 stars as soon as I feel it’s stable.

— Update 11.03.25

I have been using the app on a daily base for longer than a year.
I would love to give five stars but unfortunately I have to use it in conjunction with other calendar apps because of some missing features and bugs.
Unfortunately there are also still some bugs that are not fixed so I am giving it 3 stars only.
The worst is a bug that can be reproduced with editing recurring calendar events.

author: LKosma

title: Perfect for people with time blindness
body:
As someone with ADHD who has always struggled with time management and time blindness while using “regular” calendars, I actually really love this one because it makes time so much easier to visualise and understand and (important) I find it visually appealing while still being relatively simplistic instead of being too overloaded and overwhelming with too many features. 
Only thing that’s a bit annoying is that in the settings you have to click on each calendars settings and go to their separate settings side to change visibility of the calendar instead of just being able to change the visibility as easily as you can move the calendar from the inner to the outer ring and vice versa.

title: Apple Watch ??
body:
AppleWatch:
Nur eine Listenansicht, keine Kreis/Uhr-Darstellung,
obwohl in der Beschreibung angegeben.
Hängt dich oft auf.

Auf dem iPhone:
Sieht hübsch aus. Es fehlt eine 12 Stunden Darstellung. Die Preise (z.B. Lifetimeprice) sind nicht ansatzweise der geringen Funktionalität angemessen. Andere Entwickler können das günstiger und derzeit noch besser. Aber eventuell bewegt sich da ja noch etwas. Bisher technisch auf dem iPhone alles ok..
